run_locomujoco_preprocess: run the locomujoco CLI to preprocess AMASS motion capture data for a G1 robot
run_contact_detection: run contact detection on foot sites and smooth the contact sequence across frames
run_inverse_kinematics: run inverse kinematics regeneration using MuJoCo mocap bodies and equality constraints
run_z_axis_offset: run z-axis offset adjustment to place robot feet on the ground in initial frame
run_velocity_computation: run velocity computation from position data using mj_differentiatePos with a fixed timestep
